children: Banks have led the way on Australia's share market in recent weeks, and UBS looks at what is driving this outperformance. It speculates it is due to investors rotating out of trades related to artificial intelligence, as opposed to stellar updates on banks' profit outlooks. "Also outperforming have been real estate equities, where share prices have possibly begun to take a 'look through' view on feelings that trough valuations may have already been reached," UBS strategist Richard Schellbach says. In contrast, consumer sectors have underperformed after several retailers gave soft trading updates. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
